critical_code_review_comments: Nice-to-have: Contact form's Sonner success toast auto-dismisses very quickly (~2-3s). The response payload text is delivered and form reset works correctly, but for users on slow connections the toast could disappear before it's read. Consider raising Sonner duration to 5000ms on success. Not a blocker.

server.py: /api/contact still has NO rate-limit/captcha (carried over from iterations 2 and 3). Real MS Graph emails are sent to it.support@vegithglobal.com per request. Before public launch: add slowapi (in-memory) or Cloudflare Turnstile to prevent MS Graph abuse and per-tenant throttling.

This works but the extra 4 appear to be inlined inside IndustriesPage — consider centralising all 12 in content.js so Home + Industries pages stay in sync (Home shows 8, Industries page shows 12, which is intentional per spec, but a comment in content.js would document this).
